name: Misata Almanac
description: Synthetic data rules for realistic synthetic data: the open rulebook of how real-world records behave, for synthetic data generation, privacy-safe test data and data validation. Check-digit algorithms, identifier formats, tax rates, bank and federal holidays, currency conventions, industry code lists and official distributions, each traced to the government body, central bank, regulator or standards agency that published it, with the exact URL, a SHA-256 content hash and executable tests. Read by the Misata synthetic data engine; usable on its own as a Python library and CLI.
creator: Muhammed Rasin
